name: Matrix-Free PCG Solver
definition: A solver for the global normal system $Hx=g$ that evaluates the matrix-vector product $Hu$ directly from rasterization records without constructing $H$, using a vertex-block preconditioner.
summary: The Matrix-Free PCG Solver solves radiance-field optimization by evaluating matrix-vector products directly from rasterization records, avoiding explicit matrix assembly to maintain smaller GPU memory.
